answer: The trial I set this epoch is Dial painter pocket watch proof struck within the clock tower, and the pass mark reads each pocket watch is a tooth count weighed beside the punch mark. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof in one sitting. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 31 per proof, 18321 for 591, owed every epoch without fail. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the garden is the pass, the crystal is the fare, the walnut is the stamp — and stamps are not sold at any price. A vault of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
